Mileage & Per Diem uses your precise location to record the route and distance of trips you start. Location is used only while a trip is recording and its notification is showing.
You start every trip. Drive detection can suggest one; it never records on its own.

Android shows a notification whenever a trip is recording, so you always know location is in use and can stop it from there. Drive detection also uses notifications to suggest a trip.

Precise location is off
With approximate location, Android only knows your position to within about 3 km², so trip distances would be wrong. Turn on Precise for this app in Settings, or log trips by hand.
Open Settings
Permissions → Location
Turn on “Use precise location”
